details.description: Dobby-Unhinged-Llama-3.3-70B is a 70-billion-parameter chat model from Sentient (SentientAGI), fine-tuned from Meta's Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct to have a deliberately blunt, opinionated, pro-crypto 'unhinged' personality instead of a neutral corporate-assistant tone. Sentient positions it for companion and social agents rather than as a general safety-first assistant, and states it keeps comparable scores to the base Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct model on standard benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and BBH. It remains governed by Meta's Llama 3.3 Community License Agreement.
advantages: Maintains comparable scores to base Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct on standard benchmarks including MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and BBH, per Sentient's model card.
70 billion parameters, larger than Sentient's Mini (8B) Dobby models, per the model card's file listing.
disadvantages: Reduced neutrality by design: Sentient says the model keeps its stated opinions rather than adopting neutral or anti-crypto framing when prompted.
Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, inherited from the Llama 3.3 base model.
Deliberately unfiltered tone, including profanity and strong opinions; Sentient says users are responsible for assessing output accuracy.
use_cases: Companion and social agents designed to sound more human and opinionated than a standard assistant.

notes: The catalog id for this target ends in '-new' (dobby-unhinged-llama-3-3-70b-new); this exact id does resolve on Fireworks at fireworks.ai/models/sentientfoundation/dobby-unhinged-llama-3-3-70b-new (a prior pass tried the wrong account path and got a 404), and that host page describes the same model as Sentient's Dobby-Unhinged-Llama-3.3-70B HF card: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct base, 131,072-token context matching the catalog facts, no function calling or vision. Confirmed this is the correct model, not a guess. The HF model card gives no numeric benchmark scores beyond the comparison table (only 'comparable to base Llama-3.3-70B'), so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed.
